WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.

2. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
